# GitHub & Social Link Preview

When you share `https://github.com/D1bakar/web-scraper`, this is what people should see.

## GitHub Repository

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **Name** | web-scraper |
| **Description** | ⚡ Extract the web. Instantly. — Open-source scraper with liquid glass UI, 11 modes, price compare & REST API. Makes BeautifulSoup scripts look prehistoric. |
| **Topics** | `web-scraping` `fastapi` `python` `openapi` `docker` `data-extraction` `price-comparison` `self-hosted` |
| **Website** | (optional) link to live demo if deployed |

## Open Graph (Dashboard at `/`)

When sharing a deployed instance:

| Meta | Content |
|------|---------|
| `og:title` | Web Scraper Pro — Extract the Web |
| `og:description` | The open-source scraper with a liquid glass dashboard, 11 extraction modes, price compare, and REST API. Deploy in 60 seconds. |
| `og:type` | website |
| `og:url` | Your deployment URL or GitHub repo |

## Visual Identity

- **Primary colors:** Deep black `#06060b`, cyan `#38bdf8`, purple `#7c6ff7`, pink accent `#ec4899`
- **Aesthetic:** Liquid glass, frosted panels, floating orbs, iridescent borders
- **Hero text:** "Extract the web. Instantly."
- **Screenshot-worthy views:** Hero overlay, mode grid, price compare bar chart, confetti on job complete

## Recommended Screenshot Crop

1. Full hero with tagline and "Launch Dashboard" button
2. Mode grid with Price Compare selected (glow)
3. Price compare results with animated bar chart + share buttons

Save screenshots as `docs/images/dashboard-v2.3.png` when available for README embed.
